benefits.titleEn: It Identifies a Particular Social Group
benefits.titleZh: 指出一個特定社交群體
benefits.en: The expression does more than say rich people.; wealth; fame; fashion; luxury; public attention; glamorous social life.
benefits.zh: 這個表達不只是表示「有錢人」。 它把財富、名氣、時尚、奢華生活、傳媒關注及社交地位等意思集中在一個表達之中。

benefits.titleEn: It Makes Social Commentary More Concise
benefits.en: The idiomatic version communicates the social image more concisely.
benefits.zh: 這間咖啡店深受上流社會名流歡迎。 慣用語版本能以更簡潔的方式表達這種社會形象。

examples.en: The café is popular with the beautiful people.
examples.zh: 這間咖啡店深受上流社會名流歡迎。

benefits.en: admiration; fascination; distance; humour; criticism; irony.
benefits.zh: 它不只指出一個群體，也可以顯示說話者對這個群體的態度。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful in Media and Lifestyle Topics
benefits.titleZh: 適合傳媒及生活方式題材
benefits.en: expensive restaurants; private parties; film festivals; social media; public image.
benefits.zh: 它特別適合用於時尚、名人文化、奢華旅遊、高級餐廳、私人派對、電影節及公眾形象等題材。

benefits.titleZh: 可以配合多種句法結構
benefits.en: a subject; an object; the object of a preposition; part of a passive sentence; part of a question; part of a relative clause; part of one of the beautiful people; a possessive expression.
benefits.zh: 學生可以在不同位置自然運用同一個固定表達，而不必把五十個答案寫成同一種句式。

benefits.titleEn: It Helps Students Understand Implied Meaning
benefits.titleZh: 幫助學生理解隱含意思
benefits.en: The phrase often implies more than the individual words state directly. Students must understand that beautiful refers to a glamorous public image, not simply physical attractiveness.
benefits.zh: 這個短語的意思往往超越單字的表面意思。 學生需要理解，beautiful 在這裏代表奢華而引人注目的公眾形象，而不只是外表漂亮。

origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成；確切創始者不明

history.en: Merriam-Webster dates its first known use in the modern sense to 1950. Etymonline records the expression meaning “the fashionable set” by 1964 in Vogue. These records suggest that the modern social-group meaning became established during the mid-twentieth century, especially in writing about fashion, fame and glamorous social life. The exact first speaker or writer has not been established.
history.zh: Merriam-Webster 把這個表達現代意思的最早已知用法追溯至1950年。 Etymonline 則記錄它在 1964年的 Vogue 中已用來表示時尚社交圈。 這些記錄顯示，這個現代意思很可能在二十世紀中期逐漸固定下來，並與時尚、名氣及奢華社交生活產生密切關係。 確切的首位使用者仍未能確認。

history.en: Today, the expression refers mainly to rich, fashionable or famous people with glamorous and highly visible lifestyles. It does not necessarily mean that every member is physically attractive.
history.zh: 今天，這個表達主要指富有、時尚或著名，而且過着奢華而受人注目的生活的人。 它不一定表示每一名成員的外表都十分漂亮。

origin.memoryEn: Think of people whose wealth, fashion and public image make their lives appear “beautiful” from the outside.
origin.memoryZh: 想像一群人的財富、時尚作風及公眾形象，令他們的生活從外表看來十分「美麗」。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：不要把 beautiful 單純理解為外表漂亮
rules.en: In the target expression, beautiful does not merely describe physical appearance. The five students are very attractive. This sentence contains no information about wealth, fashion, fame or a glamorous social circle.
rules.zh: 在目標表達中，beautiful 並不只是形容外表漂亮。 這五名學生的外表十分漂亮。 這個句子沒有提及財富、時尚、名氣或奢華社交圈，因此不足以使用目標表達。

rules.en: They are beautiful people. Without the, beautiful people can be an ordinary adjective-and-noun combination.
rules.zh: 他們是很好的人/他們都是漂亮的人。 他們是時尚名人圈的一部分。 沒有 the 時，beautiful people 可以只是普通的形容詞加名詞結構。

examples.en: They are part of the beautiful people.
examples.zh: 他們是時尚名人圈的一部分。

rules.titleEn: Use a Plural Verb When the Phrase Is the Subject
rules.titleZh: 規則三：用作主語時配合複數動詞
rules.en: Use a Plural Verb When the Phrase Is the Subject
rules.zh: 時尚名流正在抵達。 時尚名流已經離開。

examples.en: The beautiful people are arriving.
examples.zh: 時尚名流正在抵達。

examples.en: The beautiful people have left.
examples.zh: 時尚名流已經離開。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Assume That Every Rich Person Belongs
rules.en: to the Group; wealth or fame; fashion; glamour; social visibility; an expensive and public lifestyle. A private business owner who avoids attention would not automatically be described as one of the beautiful people.
rules.zh: 不要假設所有富人都是 the beautiful people 這個表達通常不只是表示「有錢」，還帶有時尚、名氣、奢華社交生活及公眾關注等意思。 一名生活低調、不受公眾關注的富有商人，未必適合被形容為時尚名人圈的一員。

rules.en: The answer should not become strongly hostile. Likewise, a critical source should not become admiring.
rules.zh: 原句只是輕鬆地取笑富有而時髦的賓客，答案不應突然變成強烈攻擊。 同樣地，帶批評意味的原句也不應被改寫成欣賞語氣。

rules.en: The second sentence changes a possibility into an established fact.
rules.zh: 第二個句子把可能性變成了已確定的事實。

rules.en: The expression is useful when the social identity of the group matters.; guests; customers; actors; visitors; rich people; famous people.
rules.zh: 當這群人的時尚、財富、名氣及社會地位與語境有關時，這個表達才特別有用。 如果句子不需要強調這種名流身份，使用普通名詞可能更加準確。

rules.en: The expression can sound as though the speaker is admiring or mocking a privileged social group. Use the surrounding sentence to make the attitude clear.
rules.zh: 這個表達可能令人感到說話者正在欣賞或取笑一群享有特權的名流。 應利用上下文清楚表達說話者的態度。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Morally Good People
rules.titleZh: 規則九：不要用來表示品格善良的人
rules.en: normally refers to a fashionable, wealthy or famous social group.
rules.zh: 兩個句子的意思並不相同。

rules.titleZh: 規則十：目標表達的位置可以改變
rules.en: The target does not need to appear at the beginning of every answer. A strong exercise should vary these positions naturally.
rules.zh: 目標表達不必在每個答案中都放在句首。 高質素練習應自然改變目標表達在句中的位置。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using the beautiful people.
instructions.zh: 使用 the beautiful people 改寫句子或完成回應。
